slices.focus: Pausing weekend freelance art handling work to build an emergency cushion and reduce overall strain
slices.summary: After the crate incident and a rent increase, Hannah pauses most weekend freelance art handling work and builds a tighter budget prioritizing an emergency cushion over impulsive train-day trips to Boston or New York.
open_loops: Stick with no-most-weekend-gigs rule for at least two months
Track savings balance and weekend energy side by side
Identify which categories preserve morale vs which can be safely trimmed
decisions: Hannah has sharply cut back most weekend freelance art handling and exhibition prep work after the exhausting crate-inci
